title: 第11章 失火焦尸第12章 被首杀太阳真火
slug: 虚实梦境之主从死后开始
content_zh:
真是两位梦主，梦境联动吗？
孟天摇了摇头，他可还从来没有听说过有梦境联动的事情呢。
不过…
孟天眼神一闪，管他什么情况呢。
先把眼前空间同化了再说。
若能够掌控了这方空间，他自然能够知晓其中秘密。如此想着，孟天开始使用体内鬼气，同化周围的物体。
并且，他还引来死亡空间的力量，同步同化梦境空间。
只不过，似乎是因为他的力量太弱，还有对于周围没有掌控的原因。
他所接引而来的死亡空间力量，一次也就零点一左右。
好在源源不断。
随着孟天同化了脚下地板，死亡空间的力量，也开始以之为媒介，嵌入梦境空间。
“轰！”
霎时间，周围空间一阵扭曲。
那是梦境空间对于外来力量的排斥，不同力量对抗造成的。
只是因为侵入的力量薄弱，所以排斥力量并不是太过强烈。
当孟天再次降低一些力量之后，梦境空间的排斥力度立即再次降低。
死亡空间的力量，终于开始一点点的同化梦境空间根本，只是速度很慢。
与此同时，孟天也隐约察觉到。
这方梦境空间，似乎真的有着两个主导意识。
孟天看看徐妙妙的房间，又看看张玉的房间，露出若有所思之色。

而就在孟天思索着的时候，眼前空间突然一阵扭曲变幻。
等梦境重新稳定之后，他便看到那个最先返回的女生，突然走出房门，端着一个脸盆，来到徐妙妙的门前。
孟天远远的探头看去，能够在其中看到一些碎纸碎布。
张玉取出一个打火机，小心翼翼的引燃。
然后，她又拿起扇子，在门底下的缝隙用力扇着。
看着浓烟顺着门缝进入房间，张玉脸上浮现一抹扭曲的快意。
而她没有发现的是，一点点的火星碎纸碎布，同样被她扇进了房间。
“啊~，着火了、着火了！”
片刻过后，房间之内突然传来了徐妙妙的惊恐大叫。
“啊~！”
“砰！”
“嘿嘿嘿…”
张玉嘿嘿一笑，迅速的端盆进入洗手间，浇灭之后冲入马桶。
等她再次出来的时候，便看到徐妙妙的房间门缝，不断的向外冒着滚滚浓烟。
“这这…”
张玉瞪大了双眼，她扇进去的烟有那么大吗？
下一刻，她便看到徐妙妙的房门猛地打开，浓烟裹挟着火舌窜出，徐妙妙满脸鲜血的爬出。
content_en:
Are these two dream masters really linked in their dreams?
Meng Tian shook his head. He had never heard of dream linkage before.
But…
Meng Tian's eyes flashed, no matter what his situation was.
Let’s first assimilate the space in front of us.
If he could control this space, he would naturally know its secrets. With this in mind, Meng Tian began to use the ghost energy in his body to assimilate the surrounding objects.
Moreover, he also attracted the power of the dead space and simultaneously assimilated the dream space.
However, it seems to be because his strength is too weak and he has no control over his surroundings.
The power of the dead space he brought in was only about 0.1 at a time.
Fortunately, there is a steady stream.
As Meng Tian assimilated the floor beneath his feet, the power of the death space began to use it as a medium to embed into the dream space.
"Boom!"
In an instant, the surrounding space was distorted.
That is caused by the dream space's rejection of external forces and the confrontation between different forces.
Just because the force of invasion is weak, the force of repulsion is not too strong.
When Meng Tian lowered some of his strength again, the repulsive strength of the dream space immediately decreased again.
The power of the dead space finally began to assimilate the roots of the dream space bit by bit, but the speed was very slow.
At the same time, Meng Tian was also vaguely aware of it.
This dream space seems to have two dominant consciousnesses.
Meng Tian looked at Xu Miaomiao's room and then at Zhang Yu's room, looking thoughtful.
And while Meng Tian was thinking, the space in front of him suddenly distorted and changed.
After the dream stabilized again, he saw the girl who was the first to return suddenly walk out of the room, carrying a washbasin, and came to Xu Miaomiao's door.
Meng Tian looked over from a distance and could see some shredded paper and rags.
Zhang Yu took out a lighter and lit it carefully.
Then, she picked up the fan and fanned it vigorously in the gap under the door.
Seeing the thick smoke entering the room along the crack in the door, a twisted look of joy appeared on Zhang Yu's face.
What she didn't notice was that bits of Martian shredded paper and rags were also fanned into the room by her.
"Ah~, it's on fire, it's on fire!"
After a while, Xu Miaomiao's frightened scream suddenly came from the room.
"Ah~!"
"Bang!"
"Hey hey hey..."
Zhang Yu chuckled, quickly carried the basin into the bathroom, poured it out and flushed it into the toilet.
When she came out again, she saw thick smoke billowing out from the crack in the door of Xu Miaomiao's room.
"This, this..."
Zhang Yu's eyes widened. Was the smoke she fanned in so big?
The next moment, she saw Xu Miaomiao's door suddenly opened, thick smoke and flames came out, and Xu Miaomiao crawled out with blood on her face.
